Name: Lucky Purple Clothes
Author: AlexisBloodwood
Description:
I may say that Lewis will probably ignore your existence or completely deny that these exist. Though the fact you'll look absolutely fabulous in these is guaranteed!

Just download the mod and extract the file into your mods folder!

Need some help? Click below
[spoiler] To get the Shirt, unlock the Sewing Machine from Emily then use some Fish Roe or Void Mayonnaise with some Cloth! The Shoes, Hat, and Pants are bought at the Guild. [/spoiler]

Downloads.Description: Go out and grab the Luck of the Valley by the fibers of the fabric, young farmer.
